author: ValWood
body:
Oops sorry.

Adding a note in case it comes up again. It is an adaptor because
The binding of TLS polymerases to Rev1's CTD appears to be largely mutually exclusive (they compete for overlapping sites), which weakens the scaffold argument. If Rev1 can only hold one TLS polymerase at a time, it's functioning more as a sequential adaptor handing off between polymerases  rather than a scaffold that assembles a multi-component complex simultaneously.
So though Rev1 is often loosely called a scaffold because it coordinates the broader TLS response, it probably is an adaptor.
